scope: Read-only production configuration and historical repository source/receipt audit. This JSON receipt is the only file created. No build, upload, settings changes, real capture archive access, or real archive content writes.

historicalDistributedBuild.developerTeamEvidence: Historical installer identity and unchanged Config/AppStoreSigning.json; archive-preflight records matching app signature team.

historicalPreparedBuild88.meaning: Prepared candidate, not evidence of a distributed TestFlight version.

currentSourceIdentity.finalSignedApplicationIdentifierAndProfi: Must verify from the final archive/export; static source identity alone is not that verification.

continuity.archiveRootCodeUnchanged: FileManager applicationSupportDirectory in userDomainMask, appending DaBin. The sandboxed app with the same bundle identity normally resolves to ~/Library/Containers/com.dabin.mac/Data/Library/Application Support/DaBin.
continuity.containerQualification: Same-container reuse is the intended identity-based upgrade path. It is an inference from unchanged bundle, team, sandbox capabilities and root code; an actual Apple-signed TestFlight update on the tester Mac remains a separate acceptance check. No cross-Mac capture synchronization is implemented.
continuity.coreDataModel: DaBinV1; CaptureRecord entity; captureID UUID nonoptional; payload binaryData nonoptional; captureID uniqueness constraint.
continuity.persistentStore: metadata.store; automatic/inferred Core Data migrations disabled; no reset fallback.
continuity.capturePayload: Old86 writes10/reads1...10. Current97 writes11/reads1...11. Optional commentEntries and reminderAcknowledgment decode absent old fields without inventing dates.
continuity.workspace: Workspace.json schema1 retained; deletedScratchpads additive and optional. Old project notes/colors/orders/selections remain decodable.
continuity.drafts: Drafts.json version1 retained; new checklist/comment editing fields optional. Legacy project destination recovery retained.
continuity.taskPlanningAndOriginalLayout: TaskPlanning.swift and ProjectFileArchive.swift byte-identical to frozen86. Immutable capture timestamps/day/time zone/offset/originals retain their identity. DailyArchive adds derived comment/acknowledgment presentation, so generated mirror bytes may change.
continuity.preferences: AutoCaptureSettings.swift byte-identical to frozen86; bundle-scoped preferences/bookmarks and saved opt-in retain the same namespace.
continuity.permissions: Current root/Originals/Staging/Imports/Deletions must be owned real directories; hardened to0700. Existing leaf symlinks deliberately cause a preserved-data startup error rather than being followed.
continuity.failureBehavior: Unreadable metadata prevents startup without creating a replacement archive. Unreadable Workspace.json/Drafts.json are preserved and further writes blocked.

materialRisks: Downgrading through TestFlight to0.4.31(86) after any capture is saved by97 is unsupported: old reader rejects schema11. This does not mean the archive is deleted, but the old app can fail to open it.

Replacing an ad-hoc/direct build with Store signing is a separate channel-switch acceptance case; final signed application identifier/team and container authorization need verification. Standard TestFlight86-to97 update keeps its existing signed app identity.
Manual internal group distribution was disabled historically; upload/processing alone does not make the new build available to Personal Testing. Add the processed build to the same group.
Same Apple Account on another Mac permits TestFlight access but does not transfer DaBin local captures. Preserve each Mac own archive.

A normal old-app quit saves Drafts.json and current launch may repair derived mirrors/indexes. Compare immutable originals and semantic saved records after a clean quit; avoid claiming every SQLite/JSON byte remains identical.
recommendedBoundedSyntheticValidation: Compile isolated historical86 writer from receipt-verified frozen production sources and current97 reader from the exact upload inputs. Use only fictional fixture data in one explicit temporary root and an isolated UserDefaults suite; no default archive/clipboard/network/service startup.

Writer86 creates ordinary and whitespace-comment text, task with reminder/planning/checklist/focus state, parent-task attachment and independent imported file, trashed receipt, Unicode project/note/color, shelf/snippet/order/selection, and composer/detail drafts. Capture full semantic expected state plus per-file SHA256 and original receipt timestamps/day/time-zone/offset.

Reader97 opens that same SQLite archive, Workspace.json and Drafts.json; verifies identities, exact original bytes and legacy comments, reminders/planning, notes/colors, saved selection/order and recovered drafts. Assert old optional fields decode without invented posting dates or acknowledgments.

Make one normal save/new reply in97 and reopen twice; assert schema11 committed, all unrelated records/originals/receipt dates retained, root managed permissions0700 and repair idempotence. Handle mirrors as derived outputs, not immutable originals.

Separately confirm final signed/exported product bundle/team/application identifier, required sandbox/bookmark capabilities, Store-managed update channel/no direct updater, increasing unused build number. After Apple processing assign to Personal Testing; confirm the already-installed tester sees Update and validate its own archive after updating without uninstalling.
execution: No native tests or builds executed by this audit agent. Companion agent is preparing the exact old86-writer/current97-reader synthetic campaign for centralized execution.
